create_covariance_shrunk: create a shrunk covariance estimator with a custom shrinkage coefficient and fit it on training data
build_covariance_ledoitwolf: build a Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage covariance estimate automatically tuned to minimize MSE
test_covariance_oas: test an Oracle Approximating Shrinkage covariance estimate on training and test data
review_empirical_covariance: review the empirical covariance computation from training samples using maximum likelihood
summarize_log_likelihood: summarize the log-likelihood of test data given an estimated and a real covariance matrix
